skill.summary: Add and manage movies in a Radarr instance via its HTTP API (search/lookup movies, list quality profiles and root folders, add a movie by title/year or TMDB id, and trigger a search). Use when the user asks to add/request/download a movie via Radarr/Plex, or when automating Radarr-based media workflows.
